description: This file defines the RemoteSiloProber class, which implements the IRemoteSiloProber interface. It provides methods for probing remote silos directly and indirectly within the Orleans cluster membership system, leveraging dependency injection to obtain a MembershipSystemTarget instance and performing asynchronous operations with cancellation support.

classes.name: RemoteSiloProber
classes.description: An implementation of IRemoteSiloProber that provides remote silo probing functionalities in the Orleans membership system.

methods.name: Probe
methods.description: Probes a remote silo asynchronously, with support for cancellation.

methods.name: ProbeIndirectly
methods.description: Performs an indirect probe of a target silo via an intermediary, with a timeout and cancellation support.
